description_en: This API is used to renew a subscription-based RDS Custom instance
description_zh: 该接口用于续费一台包年包月的RDS Custom实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds renew-rc-instance --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOC0000 --commodity-code rds_customprepaid_public_00 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id rc-dh2jf9n6j4s149260000 --used-time 1 --time-type 2 --resource buy --auto-pay true --pay-type Prepaid --business-info promotion_input_param_:_promotionFilter_:_,_promotionOptionCode_:_youhui_quan --period-align true --auto-renew true --auto-use-coupon true --promotion-code 723298850000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewRCInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The commodity code of the instance.

Default value: **rds_customprepaid_public_intl**
parameters.help_zh:
商品代码。

<props="china">默认为**rds_customprepaid_public_cn**。</props>



<props="intl">默认为**rds_customprepaid_public_intl**。</props>
parameters.name: commodity_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RDS Custom instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

*   If you set the **TimeType** parameter to **1**, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from **1 to 5**. Unit: year.
*   If you set the **TimeType** parameter to **2**, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from **1 to 11**. Unit: month
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：
* 当参数**TimeType**为**1**（年）时，UsedTime取值为**1~5**。
* 当参数**TimeType**为**2**（月）时，UsedTime取值为**1~11**
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the renewal period specified by the **UsedTime** parameter. Valid values:

*   **1**: year
*   **2** (default): month
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长的时间单位，即参数**UsedTime**的单位。取值：

- **1**：年
- **2**（默认）：月
parameters.name: time_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

*   **true**: enables the feature. You must make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
*   **false**: disables the feature. An unpaid order is generated.

>  Default value: true. If your account balance is insufficient, you can set AutoPay to false to generate an unpaid order. Then, you can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console to complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值范围：

- **true**：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。
- **false**：只生成订单不扣费。




> 默认值为true。如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录RDS管理控制台自行支付。
>
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the instance. Set the value to **PrePaid**, which indicates the subscription billing method
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例的付费类型，目前仅支持**Prepaid**：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The additional information about the order
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the instance is a subscription instance. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否包年，取值范围：

- **true**：包年
- **false**（默认）：不包年
parameters.name: period_align

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动续费，取值：

* **true**：是
* **false**（默认）：否
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Default value: false. Valid values:

*   **true**: uses a coupon.
*   **false**: does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券，取值：
* **true**（默认）：使用代金券。
* **false**：不使用代金券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon
